# `nlink-lab init`

<!-- generated by `nlink-lab docs-gen`; do not edit by hand -->

```text
Create a topology file from a built-in template

Usage: nlink-lab init [OPTIONS] [TEMPLATE]

Arguments:
  [TEMPLATE]
          Template name (e.g., "router", "spine-leaf"). Use --list to see all

Options:
      --list
          List available templates

  -o, --output <OUTPUT>
          Output directory (default: current directory)

  -n, --name <NAME>
          Override the lab name

      --force
          Overwrite existing files

  -h, --help
          Print help
```
